title: Clear sign-in and safer account management
summary: Clearer email and Google access, verified account changes and simpler administrator controls.
changes: Accounts have explicit member or administrator access for each approved sign-in email.
Account changes are verified on the server with saving, error and stale-change feedback.
Adding an existing email no longer resets its role or reactivates it.
The account search is unobstructed and account actions open from Manage.
Google asks which account to use, and deactivated accounts receive a clear explanation.
